result:
The S6 tests are written and committed (`e8d51868`), and they fail on today's integrated code where they should. One step didn't happen: the required merge of `w2/integrate` into this branch, because the sandbox makes `.claude/` and `.tickets/` read-only.

**Sandbox check:** (a) writing `.sandbox-trial-DAEO-n0wb` failed with a read-only file system error, as required; (b) `git hash-object -w` and `git update-index --refresh` both worked.
**ps check:** `ps -eo pid,args | grep -iE "[o]llama|[l]lama-server"` shows nothing.

- **task:** DAEO-n0wb (W2-92), independent-test-designer, KPI line S6 (DEC-1065 (4)).
- **status:** PARTIAL. The tests are done; the merge could not be done in the sandbox.
- **work_completed:**
  - Merge: `git merge --no-ff --no-commit w2/integrate` failed on write errors under `.claude/hooks/` and `.tickets/`. No merge was recorded: HEAD, the index and every tracked file stayed as they were. It did leave 51 new files in the tree, each identical to `w2/integrate`'s copy and absent from HEAD. I deleted exactly those, plus the empty folders they left. That is my own debris, removed outside my TMPDIR, so I'm naming it here. A dry run (`git merge-tree`) shows the merge is conflict-free, before and after my commit.
  - Tests: wrote `test_w2_92_speed.py`, 15 tests. The planted project has 240 extra records and no code index. Each `retrieve` runs in a new process that counts the planted records' files it opens (an audit hook) and the front matters it parses (wrapped YAML loaders), only around that one call.
    - `test_s6a`: a plain question opens and parses at most 12 of the 240 (5 %). It has a premise test showing the counter counts one read and one parse.
    - `test_s6b`: titles come from the store. A title edited in the working tree after the load is not read. After a commit and a rebuild, the new title is found and the old one is not.
    - `test_s6c`: S1 and S4 unchanged. Ten questions get the same bundle as the integrated code `eb28c40866af`, item for item, taken from git in the test. Each must hold its named evidence, so two empty bundles never pass.
  - README: added the S6 section and map rows, starting from `w2/integrate`'s README so the CTO's merge stays clean.
- **files_changed:** `tests/acceptance/W2-92/test_w2_92_speed.py` (new), `tests/acceptance/W2-92/README.md`.
- **evidence:**
  - Red run on an exact copy of `w2/integrate` `eb28c40866af`'s code: 15 tests, 3 failed, 12 passed.
    - `s6a` (plain and unknown-id cases): "opened 240 of the 240 planted records' files".
    - `s6b` store-title case: empty bundle, because the title is read from the working file.
  - Check of the tests themselves: with the record route changed to read no file, `s6a` passes (nothing else in `retrieve` opens those records) and `s6c` fails on its two title cases (it sees the change).
  - `gov accept`'s parser maps all 5 S6 node ids to `success-6`, and the 45 tests in the folder collect.
  - TMPDIR at the end: 88K and 18 inodes.
- **tests:**
  - `test_w2_92_speed.py::test_s6a_a_plain_question_does_not_read_every_records_front_matter`
  - `test_w2_92_speed.py::test_s6a_premise_the_counter_sees_a_record_read`
  - `test_w2_92_speed.py::test_s6b_a_title_is_the_one_the_store_was_built_with`
  - `test_w2_92_speed.py::test_s6b_after_a_rebuild_the_new_title_is_the_stores`
  - `test_w2_92_speed.py::test_s6c_the_record_route_answers_as_the_integrated_code_does`
- **discoveries:**
  - The sandbox's read-only paths block the brief's merge step for any branch where `.claude/` or `.tickets/` changed.
  - A W2 id in a question still makes the integrated code read every ticket's front matter. S6 doesn't bound this because such a question names a record (S6-P2 in the README).
- **risks:**
  - S6-P1: the KPI line allows titles "read only when a question names a record"; `s6b`'s first case follows your fact that titles come from the store, and fails that other reading. Confidence medium.
  - `s6c` is pinned to `eb28c40866af`, so a later ticket that legitimately changes these bundles needs a revision (S6-P3).
- **lessons:** a merge step in launched briefs needs to run outside the sandbox, or the sandbox needs write access to `.claude/` and `.tickets/`.
- **proposed_decisions:** none.
- **unresolved:** the merge of `w2/integrate` into `w2/W2-92-tests`. It is conflict-free (merge-tree `d0c9fc7bc7ce` after my commit).
- **recommended_next_action:** the CTO runs `git merge --no-ff w2/integrate` on `w2/W2-92-tests` outside the sandbox (or merges `e8d51868` directly), then writes the marker.

TESTS-READY: W2-92 (DAEO-n0wb) S6, `tests/acceptance/W2-92/test_w2_92_speed.py`, 15 tests, red 3 of 15 on `w2/integrate` `eb28c40866af`, README map `success-6` with full node ids, commit `e8d51868`.
